description: This file defines a PHP class named 'Topic' within the namespace 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Module'. The class extends a system engine controller and includes methods for handling topic-related actions, such as fetching topics and rendering views in an OpenCart module extension. It interacts with models, manages request parameters, builds URLs, and outputs views, indicating its role in the backend logic of a CMS module.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: A controller class for handling 'topic' related operations in the Opencart CMS module extension, responsible for retrieving topics, generating URLs, and rendering the appropriate view template.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Fetches requested topic data, manages URL parameters for sorting, and renders the 'topic' view with relevant topic information and article counts.
